## Description
A mud pump (or drilling mud pump) is a reciprocating positive-displacement &#10;&#9;&#9;pump that circulates drilling fluid under high pressure (up to ~7,500 psi) &#10;&#9;&#9;down the drill string and back up the annulus.  It is the heart of the &#10;&#9;&#9;rig&#39;s circulating system, responsible for cooling the bit, carrying &#10;&#9;&#9;cuttings to the surface, and maintaining wellbore pressure.
